out_of_scope.why: The little X on the 'Set as default reader' strip is tiny and very faint grey - hard to see and hard to hit.
'Terms of Use' and 'Privacy Policy' at the bottom of the Premium page are tiny pale grey text over the renewal line - hard to read.
The Premium page is loud - big glowing orange gem picture. If any of that is animated on the real phone it would pull my attention off everything; in the still picture I can't tell.
The sheet has a big pointing hand graphic over 'Always'. If that hand animates on the phone it would grab me away from the buttons; in the still I can't tell.
The last row of Tools tiles is hidden under the bottom tab bar.
'Later' is pale grey and easy to miss next to the big black button.

Every time the app opens there's a full-screen ad with a video that plays by itself with sound and moving captions, and I can't leave until 'Continue to app' appears. That completely takes my attention - by the time I'm in the app I've half forgotten what I came to do.

The little x on the 'Set as default reader' strip is tiny and pale grey; I only found it because I was looking for it. And there's a delay of a second or two before the strip goes, with no sign that my tap landed.
The 'Manage' tiles are chopped off by the bottom bar - I only see the top of a picture and no name, so I'd have to scroll to find out what it is, and I might not bother.
